title: Anatomy and Physiology as a Science
purpose: Establish scientific inquiry and evidence expectations for human body study.

direct_resource.Title: OpenStax: Overview of Anatomy and Physiology
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the first section. Observe how anatomy focuses on structure and physiology focuses on function. Record one structure example, one function example, and one sentence explaining why form and function must be studied together.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
